author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Vibe managing is real.  I hook up my Claude Code to github, Jira, Confluence and our CI/CD and regression test, I can get real time status on everyone's work progress.   Right now, I still follow up with them using the good old email, Teams message or sync-up calls.   The technology to automate that and close the loop is just around the corner.

Do we still need the daily scrum or weekly status meeting if AI can facilitate communication better than human?
